name: Omarchy Voice
author: Yassine Sawahi
description: Omarchy on the phone: switch the voice foreman on and off, choose whether it calls you, and place a test call

barWidget.description: Phone icon for the voice foreman; lights up during a call. Middle-click turns calls to your phone on or off.

schema.label: vf-ctl command
schema.description: Path to the voice foreman's vf-ctl. Empty finds vf-ctl on PATH.
